docs.title: httpx-cache
docs.text: Zero-config, minimal-dependency response caching and deterministic replay for httpx and httpx2.

docs.title: Installation
docs.text:
pip install httpx-cache            # when httpx or httpx2 is already installed
pip install "httpx-cache[httpx]"   # install with httpx
pip install "httpx-cache[httpx2]"  # install with httpx2
pip install "httpx-cache[redis]"   # install with RedisCache support

Requires Python 3.10+ (httpx2>=2.15 requires Python 3.11+).

docs.title: Quickstart
docs.text:
import httpx, httpx_cache

client = httpx_cache.wrap(httpx.Client(), policy="force", ttl=3600)
r1 = client.get("https://httpbin.org/get")
r2 = client.get("https://httpbin.org/get")
assert r1.extensions["from_cache"] is False
assert r2.extensions["from_cache"] is True

See the User Guide, Policies & RFC 9111, API Reference, and llms.txt.

docs.title: Entry Points
docs.text:
• httpx_cache.wrap(client, *, cache=None, policy="force", ttl=None, cache_post=False, cacheable_methods=None, cacheable_status_codes=None, key_fn=None, shared=False)
  • httpx_cache.Client, httpx_cache.AsyncClient
  • httpx_cache.httpx2.Client, httpx_cache.httpx2.AsyncClient
  • httpx_cache.SyncCacheTransport, httpx_cache.AsyncCacheTransport

docs.title: 1. policy="force" (default)
docs.text:
• Ignores Cache-Control: no-store, private, no-cache, and max-age=0.
  • Caches GET and HEAD by default; pass cache_post=True (or cacheable_methods=...) to cache POST requests keyed by SHA-256 of the request body.
  • Set ttl (seconds or timedelta) for fixed expiration, or ttl=None to keep entries until evicted/cleared.

docs.title: 2. policy="replay"
docs.text:
• Strictly offline deterministic playback for unit tests and eval suites.
  • Never calls the upstream transport.
  • Ignores store TTL expiry so recorded cassettes stay reproducible over time.
  • Raises httpx_cache.CacheMissError(key, request) on any unrecorded request.

docs.title: 3. policy="rfc9111"
docs.text:
• Honors Cache-Control (no-store, no-cache, max-age, s-maxage, min-fresh, private when shared=True), Expires, Date, Age, Vary (including rejecting Vary: *), and permanent redirects (301/308).
  • Performs conditional revalidation with If-None-Match (ETag) and If-Modified-Since (Last-Modified). On 304 Not Modified, headers are merged into the cached entry and the response is returned with response.extensions["from_cache"] = True and response.extensions["revalidated"] = True.

docs.title: Wrapping an Existing Client (wrap)
docs.text:
httpx_cache.wrap(client, ...) is the recommended entry point. It inspects client to detect sync vs async and httpx vs httpx2, wraps both _transport and _mounts, and returns the same client instance:

import httpx, httpx_cache

cache = httpx_cache.SqliteCache(".cache/app.sqlite3", max_size_bytes=50 * 1024 * 1024)
client = httpx_cache.wrap(httpx.Client(), cache=cache, policy="force", ttl=3600)

with client:
    r1 = client.get("https://httpbin.org/get")
    r2 = client.get("https://httpbin.org/get")
    assert r1.extensions["from_cache"] is False
    assert r2.extensions["from_cache"] is True

The same call works unchanged with httpx.AsyncClient, httpx2.Client, httpx2.AsyncClient, and third-party SDK subclasses.

docs.title: Drop-in Clients & Transports
docs.text:
• httpx_cache.Client / httpx_cache.AsyncClient: subclasses httpx (or httpx2 if only httpx2 is installed).
  • httpx_cache.httpx2.Client / httpx_cache.httpx2.AsyncClient: explicit httpx2 subclasses when both libraries are installed.
  • httpx_cache.SyncCacheTransport / httpx_cache.AsyncCacheTransport: direct transport wrappers.

docs.title: Stores
docs.text:
• SqliteCache(path=None, max_size_bytes=None, compress=True) (default): WAL-mode SQLite file (~/.cache/httpx-cache/cache.sqlite3, or ":memory:"), indexed TTL expiry, zlib body compression (>1 KB), LRU eviction, .purge_expired().
  • MemoryCache(max_entries=None, max_size_bytes=None): thread-safe in-memory LRU.
  • FileCache(cache_dir=None, compress=True): one atomically written file per key.
  • RedisCache(redis_url=..., redis=..., aredis=..., namespace="httpx_cache", default_ttl=None): redis>=5 sync/async backend (pip install "httpx-cache[redis]").

Every store implements .get(key), .set(key, entry), .delete(key), .clear(), .stats(), and async a* variants.

docs.title: Streaming Responses
docs.text: With client.stream(...), chunks pass through untouched as you iterate. The entry is written to the cache only once the stream reaches normal EOF — aborting early never caches a partial body, and raw Content-Encoding wire streams are preserved without double-decoding.

docs.title: Custom Cache Keys (make_key_fn)
docs.text:
Pass key_fn or use httpx_cache.make_key_fn(...) to strip ephemeral query parameters, hash selected headers (safe for Authorization), and canonicalize JSON request bodies:

client = httpx_cache.wrap(
    httpx.Client(),
    cache_post=True,
    key_fn=httpx_cache.make_key_fn(
        ignore_params=("api_key", "ts"),
        include_headers=("x-tenant",),
        normalize_json_body=True,
    ),
)

Invalidate any response directly via cache.delete(response.extensions["cache_key"]).

docs.title: Pytest Record / Replay Fixture
docs.text:
httpx-cache exposes a built-in pytest plugin (httpx_cache_cassette + --httpx-cache-record=once|replay|rewrite) with zero runtime dependency on pytest:

import httpx

def test_endpoint(httpx_cache_cassette):
    with httpx_cache_cassette.wrap(httpx.Client()) as client:
        resp = client.get("https://api.example.com/items")
        assert resp.status_code == 200
